title: jacket.toml
description: Project settings for jacket, jaic, jailsp, jailint and jaifmt. https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jacket.md#jackettoml

project.markdownDescription: What to build and where its modules are.

entry.markdownDescription: The files you give `jaic`, relative to this file, such as `["main.jai"]`. Default: the first of `build.jai`, `first.jai`, `main.jai`, `src/main.jai` and `module.jai` that exists.

import_path.markdownDescription: More folders to import modules from, relative to this file (`-import_dir`).

toolchain.markdownDescription: The toolchain the project is written for.

version.markdownDescription: The `x.y.z` jaic release the project is written for; tools warn when theirs differs.

lint.markdownDescription: Settings for jailint and the lints jailsp reports.

exclude.markdownDescription: Globs (relative to this file) of files and directories not to lint: `*`, `**`, `?`.

correctness.markdownDescription: Every correctness rule: code that is wrong: it does not do what it says (default `deny`). A rule's own entry wins. [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#rules)

suspicious.markdownDescription: Every suspicious rule: code that is most likely wrong, or does nothing (default `warn`). A rule's own entry wins. [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#rules)

complexity.markdownDescription: Every complexity rule: code that says something in a roundabout way (default `warn`). A rule's own entry wins. [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#rules)

style.markdownDescription: Every style rule: code that works but is not written the usual way (default `warn`). A rule's own entry wins. [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#rules)

perf.markdownDescription: Every perf rule: code that could be faster (default `warn`). A rule's own entry wins. [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#rules)

pedantic.markdownDescription: Every pedantic rule: stricter checks with more false positives (default `allow`). A rule's own entry wins. [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#rules)

restriction.markdownDescription: Every restriction rule: checks that forbid things a project may choose to avoid (default `allow`). A rule's own entry wins. [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#rules)

absurd_comparison.markdownDescription: a comparison an unsigned value always passes or fails (`u >= 0`) (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#absurd_comparison)

almost_swapped.markdownDescription: `a = b; b = a;`, a swap that sets both to `b` (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#almost_swapped)

approx_constant.markdownDescription: a hand-typed `3.14159` or `1.4142` where `Math` has the constant (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#approx_constant)

bad_bit_mask.markdownDescription: a mask test that can never match (`(x & 4) == 1`, `(x | 2) == 0`) (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#bad_bit_mask)

assert_constant.markdownDescription: `assert(true)` or `#assert true`, which can never fail (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#assert_constant)

banner_comment.markdownDescription: a comment that is only a line of `-`, `=` or `*` fencing off a section (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#banner_comment)

bitwise_precedence.markdownDescription: a bitwise operator that binds differently than in C (`1 << n - 1`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#bitwise_precedence)

bool_to_int_with_if.markdownDescription: `ifx c then 1 else 0`, a `bool` turned into an integer with a branch (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#bool_to_int_with_if)

broken_doc_link.markdownDescription: a link in a doc comment (`[name]`) that names no declaration (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#broken_doc_link)

cognitive_complexity.markdownDescription: a procedure whose branching scores above `max_complexity` (default 25) (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#cognitive_complexity)

constant_condition.markdownDescription: an `if` or `while` whose condition the compiler shows is always true or false (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#constant_condition)

defer_frees_returned.markdownDescription: `defer free(p);` followed by `return p;`, which hands back freed memory (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#defer_frees_returned)

defer_in_loop.markdownDescription: a `defer` in a loop body that cleans up something from outside the loop (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#defer_in_loop)

double_free.markdownDescription: two `@FreesArgument` calls on the same variable with nothing in between (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#double_free)

dropped_result.markdownDescription: a call drops the `bool` that follows the values it keeps (`n := to_integer(s);`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#dropped_result)

duplicate_condition.markdownDescription: an `else if` that repeats an earlier condition (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#duplicate_condition)

element_count_as_bytes.markdownDescription: `memcpy(d, xs.data, xs.count)` with elements wider than a byte (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#element_count_as_bytes)

enum_member_prefix.markdownDescription: every member of an enum starts with the enum's name (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#enum_member_prefix)

excessive_bools.markdownDescription: a procedure with more `bool` parameters than `max_bools` (default 3) (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#excessive_bools)

identical_branches.markdownDescription: an `if`/`else` or `ifx` whose branches are the same (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#identical_branches)

identical_case_bodies.markdownDescription: two cases of a `switch` with the same body, which could list their values together (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#identical_case_bodies)

identical_operands.markdownDescription: an operator with the same expression on both sides (`a == a`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#identical_operands)

if_not_else.markdownDescription: an `if` or `ifx` with a negated condition and an `else` (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#if_not_else)

incomplete_enum_switch.markdownDescription: a `switch` on an enum that neither covers every member nor has a default case (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#incomplete_enum_switch)

impossible_comparison.markdownDescription: comparisons of one integer that never pass together (`x > 5 && x < 3`) (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#impossible_comparison)

infinite_loop.markdownDescription: a `while` whose condition nothing in the loop changes (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#infinite_loop)

integer_division_in_float.markdownDescription: an integer division whose result is used as a float (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#integer_division_in_float)

leaked_allocation.markdownDescription: a local holding memory from an `@Allocates` call that is never freed, returned or handed on (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#leaked_allocation)

lossy_float_literal.markdownDescription: a `float32` literal with more digits than a `float32` keeps (`31415.92653`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#lossy_float_literal)

loop_with_break_condition.markdownDescription: `while true { if !c break; ... }`, a loop whose condition is its first statement (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#loop_with_break_condition)

lossy_xx.markdownDescription: `xx` that narrows a number to a smaller type (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#lossy_xx)

magic_number.markdownDescription: an unexplained number in arithmetic, a comparison or an assignment (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#magic_number)

manual_clamp.markdownDescription: a value kept between two constant bounds by hand instead of with `clamp` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#manual_clamp)

manual_index_counter.markdownDescription: a counter incremented in a `for` loop that always equals `it_index` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#manual_index_counter)

min_max.markdownDescription: `min(0, max(100, x))`, a clamp that is always one bound (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#min_max)

misrefactored_assign_op.markdownDescription: `a += a + b`, an update that applies the operator to `a` twice (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#misrefactored_assign_op)

missing_doc.markdownDescription: an exported procedure, struct or enum with no doc comment (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#missing_doc)

mixed_case_hex_literals.markdownDescription: a hex literal with both upper and lower case digits (`0xDeadbeef`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#mixed_case_hex_literals)

modified_range_bound.markdownDescription: a variable bounding a `for` range assigned in the loop, which does not change it (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#modified_range_bound)

needless_bool.markdownDescription: `ifx c then true else false` and `if c return true; else return false;` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#needless_bool)

neg_cmp_float.markdownDescription: `!(a < b)` on floats, which differs from `a >= b` when a value is NaN (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#neg_cmp_float)

needless_continue.markdownDescription: a `continue` as the last thing a loop body does (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#needless_continue)

no_effect.markdownDescription: a statement that computes a value and drops it (`x == 5;`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#no_effect)

print_in_module.markdownDescription: a module writes to the program's output (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#print_in_module)

range_past_count.markdownDescription: `for i: 0..xs.count` indexing `xs[i]`, one past the end (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#range_past_count)

redundant_alias.markdownDescription: a local that only exists to be copied into another local or returned (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#redundant_alias)

redundant_cast.markdownDescription: a cast to the type the value already has (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#redundant_cast)

remove_in_for.markdownDescription: removing from an array while a `for` walks it forward (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#remove_in_for)

returned_local_address.markdownDescription: `return *x;` with `x` a local, a pointer into a stack frame that is gone (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#returned_local_address)

reversed_range.markdownDescription: a range whose start is above its end, which never runs (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#reversed_range)

self_assignment.markdownDescription: a value assigned to itself (`x = x;`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#self_assignment)

shift_overflow.markdownDescription: a shift by at least the bit width of its operand (`x << 40` with `x: s32`) (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#shift_overflow)

shadowed_it.markdownDescription: a nested `for` hides an `it` the enclosing loop uses (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#shadowed_it)

single_case_switch.markdownDescription: a `switch` with a single case, which is an `if` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#single_case_switch)

string_literal_write.markdownDescription: a write into a string literal, which is read-only (`s := "abc"; s[0] = x;`) (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#string_literal_write)

todo_marker.markdownDescription: a comment with a `TODO`, `FIXME`, `XXX` or `HACK` marker (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#todo_marker)

too_many_arguments.markdownDescription: a procedure with more parameters than `max_arguments` (default 7) (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#too_many_arguments)

unchecked_directive.markdownDescription: `#no_abc`, `#no_aoc` or `#asm` with no comment saying why (default `allow`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unchecked_directive)

uninit_read.markdownDescription: a variable declared `= ---` read before anything is written to it (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#uninit_read)

unnecessary_force_cast.markdownDescription: `cast,force` where the value already has the type or the conversion widens (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unnecessary_force_cast)

unknown_allow.markdownDescription: a `// jailint: allow(...)` comment naming a rule that does not exist (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unknown_allow)

unpaired_lock.markdownDescription: a `@Locks` call with a path that returns or ends without a matching `@Unlocks` (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unpaired_lock)

unsigned_range_end_minus_one.markdownDescription: `for 0..n-1` with an unsigned `n`, which wraps around when `n` is 0 (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unsigned_range_end_minus_one)

unused_import.markdownDescription: an `#import` nothing in its scope uses (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_import)

unused_parameter.markdownDescription: a parameter the procedure never uses (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_parameter)

unused_result.markdownDescription: a call to a `@UseResult` procedure, as a statement (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_result)

unused_variable.markdownDescription: a local variable that is never used (default `warn`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#unused_variable)

use_after_free.markdownDescription: a variable read after a `@FreesArgument` call freed it (`free(p); use(p);`) (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#use_after_free)

wrapping_constant.markdownDescription: a constant that wraps to the type the other operand gives it (`(0xffff_ffff - 40) / h`) (default `deny`). [Docs](https://github.com/matteopolak/jacket/blob/main/docs/tools/jailint.md#wrapping_constant)

max_nesting.markdownDescription: How many blocks deep code may nest before `excessive_nesting` fires.

max_complexity.markdownDescription: The cognitive complexity above which `cognitive_complexity` reports a procedure.

max_arguments.markdownDescription: The parameter count above which `too_many_arguments` reports a procedure.

max_bools.markdownDescription: The number of `bool` parameters above which `excessive_bools` reports a procedure.

magic_number_allow.markdownDescription: Numbers `magic_number` never reports, besides `10`, `100`, `1000`, powers of two and all-ones masks, such as `[60, 24, 3.14159]`.

magic_number_min.markdownDescription: Whole numbers smaller than this in magnitude are not reported by `magic_number`.

magic_number_in_tests.markdownDescription: `magic_number` also checks files in `tests` and `test` folders.

overrides.markdownDescription: Rule levels for some paths. Each entry's `rules` win over `[lint.rules]` for the files its `paths` match; a later entry wins over an earlier one, and command-line flags win over both.

paths.markdownDescription: Globs (relative to this file) of the files these levels apply to: `*`, `**`, `?`.

case_indent.markdownDescription: Indentation of `case` lines in `if x == {`. Default: `indent_width`.

case_body_indent.markdownDescription: Indentation of the statements under a `case`. Default: `indent_width`.

max_width.markdownDescription: Line width reported by `jaifmt --verbose`; lines are never wrapped.

brace_style.markdownDescription: `same_line` joins a `{` on its own line to its header; `preserve` leaves it.

ignore.markdownDescription: Globs (relative to this file) of files and directories not to format.

experimental.markdownDescription: Performance knobs that may change between releases; each becomes a `jaic` flag.

parse_threads.markdownDescription: Threads that parse files ahead of the compiler (`-parse_threads`).

serial_parse.markdownDescription: Parse files one at a time (`-serial_parse`).

codegen_units.markdownDescription: Split code generation into this many units (`-codegen_units`).
